title: A comprehensive review on graphene-/graphitic carbon nitride-based MOFs for the photocatalytic purification of dye wastewater
content:

The development of advanced porous functional materials with enhanced photocatalytic performance for the degradation of hazardous dye pollutants has led to the emergence of graphene/graphitic carbon nitride-based MOFs as promising photocatalysts.
